# Answers: Telling the time and the days of the week

## Before you start
1. "Es" agrees with one hour, "la una"; every other hour is plural. Source: [SpanishDict: Telling time in Spanish](https://www.spanishdict.com/guide/telling-time-in-spanish)
2. "El lunes", with the article and no preposition. Source: [SpanishDict: Telling time in Spanish](https://www.spanishdict.com/guide/telling-time-in-spanish)

## Retrieval practice
1. The verb agrees with the hour: "la una" is singular, "las dos" plural. Source: [SpanishDict: Telling time in Spanish](https://www.spanishdict.com/guide/telling-time-in-spanish)
2. One model: "El sábado me levanto a las nueve y voy al mercado a las once." Other wordings are right too. Source: [Words](#words)
3. "El viernes". Source: [Words](#words)
4. One model: "¿A qué hora empieza la película?" Source: [Words](#words)
